entries.candidate: TierPoint Oklahoma City data centers OKC and OK2 (4121 and 4114 Perimeter Center Place, Oklahoma City, OK 73112)
entries.reason: TierPoint's Oklahoma City page (captured tierpoint-okc-20261023.html; dateModified 2026-09-03, bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 15 February 2026 listed in ia-cdx-tierpoint-okc.json) says 'TierPoint operates two state-of-the-art data centers' at 4121 Perimeter Center Place (22,000+ sq ft, 14,000+ sq ft raised floor) and 4114 Perimeter Center Place (69,000+ sq ft, 34,000+ sq ft raised floor), so operational status on 3 September 2026 is supportable. No allowed parcel source was found: the City of Oklahoma City GIS returned a bot challenge to the previous pass, the Oklahoma County Assessor's robots.txt returns HTTP 403, and the ArcGIS Online proxy of the City's licensing/zoning layer (utility.arcgis.com) was not used because it would route around the City's challenge. No geocoder or city centre is acceptable.
entries.reopen_condition: An Oklahoma County Assessor or City of Oklahoma City parcel (or address point) for 4121/4114 Perimeter Center Place reachable by plain GET without a challenge, while the 3 September 2026 observation is within 85 days (until 2026-11-27); then admit as one site with one project covering both buildings, or two sites if the parcels are separate campuses.

entries.candidate: Meta 'Project Anthem', Wagoner County, Oklahoma (Oklahoma DEQ air permit 2026-0325-NOI, facility 'META PROJECT ANTHEM', permittee Mobicon Crushing and Recycling LLC)
entries.reason: The Oklahoma DEQ list of air permits issued in the past year (captured by the previous pass, okdeq-permits-issued-past-year.csv) shows a crusher notice of intent issued on 1 May 2026 for a facility named 'META PROJECT ANTHEM' in Wagoner County. It is a contractor's portable-crusher permit, outside the 85-day window, and it most likely concerns the existing Atlas record imported:semiconductor-atlas:meta-tulsa, whose locator is a Tulsa city point (locality context; Meta says East Tulsa). A locator replacement for an existing record cannot be expressed, and the permit is not a data-centre status observation.
entries.reopen_condition: A separate geometry correction for the Meta Tulsa record using a Meta, City of Tulsa, Wagoner County or DEQ record that places Project Anthem on a parcel or coordinate; the crusher NOI can then be attached as identity context.

entries.candidate: Atmoss Data Center (Atmoss LLC), Wagoner County, Oklahoma (Oklahoma DEQ air permit 2026-0025-O)
entries.reason: The DEQ list of air permits issued in the past year shows permit 2026-0025-O issued on 15 January 2026 to Atmoss LLC for 'ATMOSS DATA CENTER' in Wagoner County. entries.reopen_condition: An in-window DEQ document, operator statement or Wagoner County record naming the Atmoss data centre with its coordinate or parcel; check first whether it is a commercial data centre or a crypto-mining or enterprise installation.
